review.method_name: Clipping-enhanced Kramers-Kronig receiver with logarithmic main-path processing
experimental_conditions: Numerical simulations of Kramers-Kronig SSB reception with 16-QAM signals
Back-to-back and 100 km standard single-mode-fiber cases
Carrier-to-signal power ratios of 6-9 dB and thermal noise of 60 pA/sqrt(Hz)
Receiver sensitivity evaluated at a BER target of 2.3 x 10^-4 / KP4 FEC
main_results: Combining logarithmic processing and clipping obtained low error rates with 2 dB less carrier power and 0.25 dB better sensitivity than conventional processing
At 100 km, reported logarithmic and clipping receiver sensitivity was -5.76 dBm versus -5.58 dBm for conventional KK
The improved processing potentially supports analogue implementation using semiconductor diodes
